h: Shabbos Makes the Jewish Heart a Dwelling for Holiness

p: of the Field of holy Apples."
from which all the souls blossom forth,
as is written in Sefer HaBahir;
and the souls of Yisrael are the holy apples.
And the site of the Mikdash, before it was built,
'The Beis HaMikdash will be built in my territory,' etc.;
'And it was when they were in the field,'
and 'field' means nothing but the Beis HaMikdash,
'Zion shall be plowed as a field.'"
And the beginning of Creation was
so that the Shechinah would be among the lower beings;
the site of the Mikdash remained,
and it is called a field;
and likewise after the actual destruction
it is also called a field.
And at the time when it is Shabbos,
it is like a Mikdash in place;
for on Shabbos the Shechinah rests
and this is the Field of holy Apples.
"'The earth and its fullness are Hashem's' (Tehillim 24:1):
this is the Holy Land, etc.
which is called "earth" in the holy Zohar
Rather, these are the souls of the righteous, etc.";
that from there all the souls blossom forth.
כִּי הוּא עַל יַמִּים יְסָדָהּ כוּ׳
"'For He founded it upon the seas,' etc.:
which flows and goes out of Eden, etc."
And there are mentioned in this the three Shabbos meals,
which are the initials of ONeG,
(as is written in the holy Zohar
חֵלֶק א כו סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
and they are the holiness of the three Avos;
for Shabbos is shin and bas,
the Daughter crowned with the Avos,
as is written in the holy Zohar
"Who shall ascend the mountain of Hashem?"
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponding to the holiness of Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
That is, one must ascend as up a mountain,
"And he saw the place from afar";
and it is written, "Who shall ascend, etc.,"
"And who shall stand in His holy place?"
כְּנֶגֶד מִדַּת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponding to the trait of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
אֵין זֶה כִּי אִם בֵּית אֱלֹקִים
This is none other than the house of God."
for there is rest in it.
And it says who can merit
for all deeds are named after the hands;
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this corresponds to Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
who was quick in the performance of mitzvos,
that is, fear, which is called heart,
עַל מִי שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
about one who has no fear of Heaven";
and that is Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom,
whose trait is "the Fear of Yitzchak."
וְהוּא גַּם כֵּן מֶרְכָּבָה לְמִדַּת בִּינָה
And he is also a chariot for the trait of binah,
and it is written (Yeshayahu 6:10), "and his heart will understand,"
"Then you will understand the fear of Hashem."
"Who has not taken My soul in vain"
נֶגֶד מִדַּת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the trait of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
which is the opposite of the wicked Esav,
"Here is the vanity that I created in My world";
And it says in the holy Zohar:
Rather, it is all one thing,
'Hashem has sworn by His soul,' etc.;
For the trait of Malchus is called "My soul,"
is a chariot for the trait of Malchus.
And all the holiness of Shabbos
the Daughter crowned with the Avos.

p: this is the dust of the Holy Land,
and from there he was created,
and that is the site of the Beis HaMikdash;
'and He blew into his nostrils the breath of life'
that is drawn from that life above, etc."
are from the Bond of Life,
which is the trait of Malchus,
and it is drawn from the life above,
(printed at the end of the volume)
and it is comprised in it,
And this is what we find in the Gemara (Beitzah 16a):
HaKadosh Baruch Hu gives to a person
And the Gemara calls it neshamah,
even though only nefesh is alluded to;
but since it is comprised in the trait of Malchus,
it is called neshamah, as said.
And each one of Yisrael merits
walks in the path of truth,
and his mouth and his tongue
this soul cleaves to him, etc."
corresponds to the trait of Yaakov,
for it is the service of the heart.
And prayer too is of the trait of fear,
מִי בָכֶם יְרֵא ה׳ (יְשַׁעְיָה נ, י)
about one who regularly comes to the beis haknesses";
"'They will fear You with the sun' (Tehillim 72:5)
"Let one not refrain from pleading for mercy,
כִּי אֶת הָאֱלֹקִים יְרָא (קֹהֶלֶת ה, ו)
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this corresponds to Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom.
"It is revealed and known before You
that I toiled with my ten fingers in Torah."
that whoever merits these three traits,
all Yisrael are called "those who fear My Name"
and that corresponds to "pure of heart";
"He who keeps the Shabbos from profaning it
and keeps his hand from doing any evil";
and it is stated in the Mechilta (Beshalach, Vayassa 6)
And regarding Shabbos it is stated
(at the beginning of chapter 4 of Demai):
and eat it on his word";
and it is stated in the Yerushalmi:
"The awe of Shabbos is upon the am ha'aretz"
that is, he does not lie;
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד מִדַּת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this corresponds to the trait of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom:
"who has not taken My soul in vain."
And therefore it is stated in the holy Zohar
that those who toil in Torah
"And those that are added to the holy people
walk in the path of truth,
and their mouth and tongue speak
And afterward it says in the holy Zohar:
and the holy Shechinah rests upon him."
"Who spreads the shelter of peace over us," etc.,
as the Rishonim, of blessed memory, wrote
in the name of the Midrash of the parable:
when the king is in his house,
"And the holy Shechinah rests upon him"
"for their generations," le'dorosam, read as dirasam, their dwelling;
and it is stated in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 48):
for whom he makes a dwelling on Shabbos
in the two chambers of the heart, etc."
